body:
The cause appears to a change introduced in #19318. More specifically, authorization checks for `/{org}/teams/-/search` (defined [here](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/51c8c0f3feb6b71ff5bf45e9e1422f2428eb7f5f/routers/web/web.go#L640)) are tighter than they used to be with the `/api/v1/...` endpoint.

In [this line](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/51c8c0f3feb6b71ff5bf45e9e1422f2428eb7f5f/routers/web/web.go#L691) `Context.OrgAssignment(...)` is called with the parameters `requireMember` and `requireOwner`. I'm not sure whether the original intention was "require membership OR ownership" or "require membership AND ownership", but normal members are sorted out in [this line](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/51c8c0f3feb6b71ff5bf45e9e1422f2428eb7f5f/modules/context/org.go#L113).
What did you mean `normal user`? This interface should be visited only by orgniazation owner team members or repository's admin collobrators.
Sorry, I should have specified: With `normal user` I meant repository admin collaborators who are not organization owners.
Looks like it's a regression from #19318

The problem is should the admin permission collaborator of organization repositories can visit organization's users list. If this collaborator is not a member of this organization. I think it's difficult to say it could. But he can visit public users list.

issue.title: Don't require team membership for team search results

issue.body:
Another regression from #18518. 

Note that tests for other routes expect non-team-members not to have access to it:
- https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/4aafe26007b51e806bd9529870def18223bc18f5/tests/integration/api_team_test.go#L42
- https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/79224316ae7db8cbdcf577a512e27ff4e8033ead/routers/web/org/teams.go#L342

But I'd argue this assumption breaks the quite valid use-case of searching for teams you are not a member of.
Also the `/api/v1/orgs/{org}/teams` endpoint (available to org members)  will happily list all existing teams, so there is some inconsistency here already. I'd say you don't need to be team member to see details, as the information gained is not exactly sensitive.

related discussion for permissions in the frontend:
- #20844
- https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/issues/20658
